declaration.question: At a budget of 25 distinct architectures, how far from the exact Pareto front does each algorithm get?
declaration.metric: IGD+ to the exact front at 25 distinct architectures
declaration.rope_source: 6 algorithms x 13 seeds on the complete 1,099-architecture table, pooled within algorithm so real differences between them are removed (6 configurations x 13 seeds)
declaration.notes: The front is exact rather than estimated, because every architecture under the ceiling was trained and measured. The budget axis is distinct architectures rather than evaluations: a campaign pays to train an architecture once, and charging for repeats penalises algorithms that keep an archive over ones that forget.

rope.metric: IGD+ to the exact front at 25 distinct architectures
rope.source: 6 algorithms x 13 seeds on the complete 1,099-architecture table, pooled within algorithm so real differences between them are removed (6 configurations x 13 seeds)
rope.description: 0.00896235 on IGD+ to the exact front at 25 distinct architectures, from 0.5x the standard deviation of 78 replicates of 6 algorithms x 13 seeds on the complete 1,099-architecture table, pooled within algorithm so real differences between them are removed (6 configurations x 13 seeds) (mean 0.0346263, sd 0.0179247, range 0.105392)
rope.why: Derived from repeated measurements under identical conditions, so it is the floor below which no claim about architecture can be made: that much movement happens with nothing changed.

power.why: Friedman's statistic cannot exceed blocks x (treatments - 1), so below 3 blocks no arrangement of ranks reaches significance and a high p-value means the test had no power rather than that the treatments agree.
